others.route: Artist entry visa (General Security, artists department)

note: Lebanon: an artist coming to work needs the entry visa General Security's artists department issues, applied for by the firm or convener with the dates, length and pay of the work, and may work at most six months without a break, returning only after an absence as long as the last stay (Arab artists and members of international groups exempted from that limit). No days without the visa.

sources.title: General Directorate of General Security (Lebanon), Artistic Enterprises
sources.said: The artists that wish to work in Lebanon, have to have an entry visa in hand that has been delivered by the general security – artist department. The interested party has to apply for this visa, whether it’s the firm or the convener, they must specify the date and duration of work, as well as the remuneration of the artist.
